name: OSS_ENT_PLAN_CHARGE_RULES
description: This table is used to capture entitlement volume pricing charge rule.

columns.name: ENT_PLAN_CHARGE_RULE_ID
columns.description: This field uniquely identifies the specific entitlement plan charge rule associated with each row in the dataset.

columns.name: ENT_PLAN_CHARGE_RULE_NUMBER
columns.description: This field acts as an alternative identifier for the entitlement plan charge rule associated with the row.

columns.name: ENTITLEMENT_PLAN_ID
columns.description: This field tracks the identifier of entitlement plan associated with the row.

columns.name: BALANCE_PROFILE_ID
columns.description: This field tracks the identifier of balance profile associated with the row.

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_PRODUCT_ID
columns.description: This field tracks the identifier of subscription product associated with the row.

columns.name: PRODUCT_ENTITLEMENT_PLAN_ID
columns.description: This field tracks the identifier of product entitlement plan associated with the charge.

columns.name: CHARGE_DEFINITION_ID
columns.description: This field tracks the identifier of subscription charge definition associated with the profile charge associated with the profile.

columns.name: BALANCE_CODE_ID
columns.description: This field tracks the identifier of balance code for given entitlement plan charge rule.

columns.name: BALANCE_CODE_UOM
columns.description: This field tracks the unit of measure of balance code for given entitlement plan charge rule.

columns.name: BALANCE_CODE_UOM_CLASS
columns.description: This field tracks the unit of measure class of balance code for given entitlement plan charge rule.

columns.name: ELIGIBILITY_BALANCE_CODE_ID
columns.description: This field tracks the identifier of subscription balance code which is eligible for aggregation.

columns.name: AGGREGATION_BALANCE_CODE_ID
columns.description: This field tracks the identifier of subscription balance code which is used in aggregation.

columns.name: AGGREGATION_PERIOD
columns.description: This field tracks the aggregation period for given entitlement plan charge rule.

columns.name: AGGREGATION_PERIOD_BASE_UOM
columns.description: This field tracks the base unit of measure of aggregation period for given entitlement plan charge rule.

columns.name: AGGREGATION_PERIOD_CONV_RATE
columns.description: This field tracks the conversion rate of aggregation period for given entitlement plan charge rule.

columns.name: VOL_PRICING_ELIGIBILITY_FLAG
columns.description: This field tracks the eligibility  property for given entitlement plan charge rule.

columns.name: VOL_PRICING_AGGREGATION_FLAG
columns.description: This field tracks the aggregation property for given entitlement plan charge rule.

columns.name: CHARGE_PRICE_TYPE
columns.description: This field tracks the type of the price associated with the charge.

columns.name: BALANCE_CODE_TYPE
columns.description: This field tracks the type of the balance associated with the balance code.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
